subject: AI’s circuit board crunch 🖥️, Google simplifies GKE networking ☁️, missing AI failures 🤖
notes: No rounds, acquisitions, IPOs, funds or AI model pricing in this issue. Sponsor block (Teleport) ignored.

stories.headline: Global Electronics Association warns AI server demand is straining circuit board supply; relief unlikely before mid-2028
stories.quote: The Global Electronics Association warns that AI server demand is straining circuit board supplies and crowding out automotive, medical, and industrial orders.

facts.text: Meaningful supply relief unlikely before mid-2028
facts.quote: Increasingly complex boards consume more materials and manufacturing capacity, with meaningful supply relief unlikely before mid-2028.

stories.headline: Canonical targets Ubuntu 28.04 LTS for Core Desktop, tentatively default download in 30.04
stories.quote: Canonical is targeting Ubuntu 28.04 LTS for Core Desktop, with a tentative goal of making it the default download in 30.04.

stories.headline: Google announces general availability of ambient networking for GKE
stories.quote: Google has announced the general availability of ambient networking for Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE), introducing a sidecar-less service mesh architecture into production.

stories.headline: AWS previews centralized Network Firewall filtering at VPC internet gateways
stories.quote: AWS Network Firewall can now apply centralized filtering rules directly at VPC internet gateways without requiring routing or architectural changes.

stories.headline: GitHub releases release candidate for GitHub Enterprise Server 3.23
stories.quote: GitHub has released the release candidate for GitHub Enterprise Server 3.23, introducing new platform capabilities including improved filtering in GitHub Projects, AI-powered secret detection for air-gapped environments, and expanded malware detection across multiple package ecosystems.

stories.headline: Microsoft acknowledges application failures after November Windows 11 hotpatch, gives Registry workaround
stories.quote: Microsoft has acknowledged application failures following November's Windows 11 hotpatch and provided a Registry workaround requiring a restart.
